answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 31206 Country: India Title: Please tell me whether salat al tawaf is a nafl salah or wajib salah. Question: Please tell me whether salat al tawaf is a nafl salah or wajib salah. Answer ID: 31206 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 611/611/M=1432) It is wajib to offer two rakah salah after each tawaf. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
